definitions.gloss: to have a meal, to dine
definitions.explanation: To eat a meal; used of regular meals rather than snacks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦しません→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Would you like to have a meal together?

examples.japanese: ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食事|しょくじ}して⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}ります→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: I'll eat out before coming home.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{食事|しょくじ}した。
examples.english: Yesterday I had a meal with a friend at a restaurant.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ないで→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't look at your phone while you're eating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}に→一緒：02848_issho⟧{食事|しょくじ}する⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にしています→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧。
examples.english: I value the time I spend having meals with my family.

notes:
⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧ refers to the act of eating a meal or to a meal itself. Slightly more formal than ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧, the everyday word for meals.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive; no transitive pair.
- What you eat is not its object: say ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧, not ⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食事|しょくじ}する.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {食事|しょくじ}する / ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to have a meal
- {食事中|しょくじちゅう}: during a meal
- ⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧: a light meal
- {食事制限|しょくじせいげん}: dietary restriction

REGISTER:
⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧ is used in both speech and writing but sounds slightly formal. In everyday conversation, ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧ or ⟦{飯|めし}→飯：03805_meshi⟧ (casual, masculine) is more natural.
